title: Parameter "SceneTree::get_singleton()" is null error on custom setter in resource in theme resource set as the GUI theme
body: ### Tested versions v4.5.stable.official [876b29033], v4.6.dev1.official [8d8041bd4] ### System information Godot v4.6.dev1 - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Mon, 06 Oct 2025 18:48:29 +0000 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 (nvidia; 580.95.05) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-12900K (24 threads) - 46.80 GiB memory ### Issue description Custom setters inside resources will through the error ``` E 0:00:00:813 icon_texture_2d.gd:5 @ @implicit_new(): Parameter "SceneTree::get_singleton()" is null. scene/debugger/scene_debugger.cpp:491 @ parse_message() icon_texture_2d.gd:5 @ @implicit_new() ``` when placed in a Theme resource set as the theme in the project settings ### Steps to reproduce ```gdscript class_name MyTexture2D extends Texture2D @export var init: int = 5: set(value): print(value) ``` Then, instantiate this custom resource inside a theme as an icon: Set the theme as the GUI theme (`gui/theme/custom`). Run the game, and a few errors should appear in the debugger: ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [theme-resource-scenetree-null.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22912402/theme-resource-scenetree-null.zip)
